# BTicino C300X Integration v1.6.6

## Fixed

- Keeps passive Ring Call preview browsers in sync after another browser
  answers the call, so they no longer freeze on a stale busy view.
- Returns open Ring Call cards to idle after the answered browser hangs up.
- Keeps Ring media state priority stable while the browser stream transitions.
- Hardens native self-test and device-user route handling.
- Avoids exposing optional media conversion dependency details in HTTP error
  responses.

## Changed

- Adds safe media timeline diagnostics for media/session troubleshooting.

## Upgrade Notes

- Restart Home Assistant after updating.
- Hard-reload all open Home Assistant browser dashboards after updating so the
  bundled card module is refreshed from the installed integration version.
- Update the native C300X device agent from Home Assistant to `1.6.6`.
